  "milestones": [
    {
      "id": "m1",
      "title": "Add FORMAT_RFC3339_STRICT constant",
      "requests": [
        "R2"
      ],
      "requirement": "I need a new format constant that uses the 'T' separator for strict RFC3339 compliance, distinct from the existing space-separated one.",
      "observable": "arrow.FORMAT_RFC3339_STRICT is defined as a string containing 'T'. arrow.Arrow.utcnow().format(arrow.FORMAT_RFC3339_STRICT) contains 'T' between date and time parts.",
      "public_names": [
        "FORMAT_RFC3339_STRICT"
      ],
      "requires": [],
      "why_requires": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "m2",
      "title": "Migrate internal timezone handling to ZoneInfo",
      "requests": [
        "R4",
        "R7"
      ],
      "requirement": "Replace internal usage of pytz/dateutil tz with standard library zoneinfo.ZoneInfo and datetime.UTC to remove deprecation warnings and modernize dependencies.",
      "observable": "Calling arrow.now() or arrow.get() with timezone strings does not raise DeprecationWarning related to datetime.utcnow() or pytz. Internal factory methods use ZoneInfo. utcnow() uses datetime.now(datetime.UTC) instead of datetime.utcnow().",
      "public_names": [
        "utcnow",
        "now",
        "get",
        "_get_tzinfo"
      ],
      "requires": [],
      "why_requires": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "m3",
      "title": "Add week_start parameter to floor and ceil",
      "requests": [
        "R1"
      ],
      "requirement": "The floor() and ceil() methods should accept an optional week_start parameter to define which day (0-6) starts the week when flooring/ceiling to weeks.",
      "observable": "Arrow(2023, 10, 5).floor('week', week_start=1) returns Arrow for Monday. Arrow(2023, 10, 5).ceil('week', week_start=0) returns Arrow for Sunday. Default behavior (no arg or None) preserves existing logic (typically Monday start).",
      "public_names": [
        "floor",
        "ceil"
      ],
      "requires": [
        "m2"
      ],
      "why_requires": "floor and ceil rely on internal timezone utilities (_get_tzinfo via span_range or direct calls) to ensure consistent timezone handling when calculating week boundaries, which are updated in m2."
    },
    {
      "id": "m4",
      "title": "Add check_imaginary parameter to shift method",
      "requests": [
        "R6"
      ],
      "requirement": "The shift() method needs a check_imaginary parameter (default True) to optionally skip DST/imaginary time checks for performance when the user knows no such transitions occur.",
      "observable": "Arrow(2023, 3, 12, 2, 30, tz='US/Eastern').shift(hours=1, check_imaginary=False) returns a valid Arrow without raising an exception or correcting the imaginary time. With check_imaginary=True (default), it raises ValueError or adjusts depending on implementation details of 'imaginary' handling in this library version (usually raises or corrects). The key observable is the parameter existence and its effect on execution path.",
      "public_names": [
        "shift"
      ],
      "requires": [
        "m2"
      ],
      "why_requires": "shift relies on _get_tzinfo (updated in m2) to resolve timezone expressions before performing any imaginary time checks, ensuring the underlying datetime object has a proper ZoneInfo-based tzinfo."
    }
  ],
  "expected_causes": [
    "Developers might miss updating all call sites of _get_tzinfo during migration (m2)",
    "Week start logic in floor/ceil might conflict with existing span_range defaults if not carefully isolated (m3)",
    "check_imaginary logic in shift must correctly identify 'imaginary' times which can be subtle around DST gaps (m4)"
  ],
  "verifier_plan": "Tests will import arrow and check: 1) FORMAT_RFC3339_STRICT exists and formats correctly. 2) No deprecation warnings are raised during basic operations involving timezones, and internal helpers use ZoneInfo. 3) floor/ceil accept week_start kwarg and produce expected dates for non-default week starts, working correctly with the new timezone infrastructure. 4) shift accepts check_imaginary kwarg and skips validation when False, relying on the migrated timezone handling."
}
